column4: Total time and savings deposits in domestic offices (the pre-1984 split: demand vs time and savings, including NOW/ATS and Super NOW accounts), 1976Q1-2010Q4; the domestic companion of demand_dep_tot. No consolidated series exists (the consolidated code is a copy of the domestic one in the source). The filed item equals total domestic deposits minus demand deposits (RCON2200 - RCON2210) exactly for 99.3-99.8% of banks in every era, except 1984Q1-Q2: there the new forms moved NOW/ATS and Super NOW accounts out of it (the $0.109tn gap at 1984Q1 is exactly transaction minus demand deposits), and 1984Q2 is filed by only 1,325 banks. For those two quarters the series is RCON2200 - RCON2210, which equals the filed item plus the NOW-type accounts for 98.5% of banks in 1984Q1.
